name: @waste/documents
description: The documents the platform renders: an invoice's or a credit note's PDF (#291 slice 5, #292 C5) from the model @waste/domain/finance/invoice-document makes of the ledger's rows, and an unload's waste transfer note (O18 of #290) from @waste/domain/execution/transfer-note's, through pdf-lib, pure JavaScript with the PDF standard fonts, no headless browser. pdf-lib is loaded by a dynamic import inside the render, never at boot, since the Pilot runs the API and the worker in one 256 MiB cgroup (#134); its version is pinned exactly, and the renderer's golden sha256 is held to that pin, so a bump that moves a byte is a visible change. Deterministic: the same model renders the same bytes. Server-only: apps/web is fenced out in eslint.config.mjs the way @waste/db is. Ships TypeScript source for tsx consumers.
